steps.heading: Three gestures. No friction.
steps.subhead: No editor to open. No window to focus. Lexena lives in your tray and types into whatever you're already looking at.

items.title: You press the key.
items.body: Customizable global shortcut. Toggle, push-to-talk, or both. Works everywhere — Word, Slack, VS Code, browser, terminal.

items.title: You speak.
items.body: A floating mini-window shows the audio level and timer in real time. AI post-processing is opt-in and toggleable per dictation.

items.title: The text appears.
items.body: Auto-pasted into the active app instantly. A copy is kept in history with replayable audio — never without your permission.

items.title: Email, reports, drafts.
items.body: You speak faster than you type. Lexena reframes on the fly if you want — pro tone, email tone, bullet list, summary.

items.title: Pull requests, tickets, snippets.
items.body: Local Whisper on GPU so nothing leaves your machine. Configurable hotkeys, personal dictionary, snippet expansion for the acronyms no model recognizes.
items.footnote: Built for devs and power users.

items.title: Connected notes.
items.body: Rich TipTap editor, @ backlinks, task lists, code blocks. Watertight Personal/Work profiles. Voice-captured thoughts, keyboard-organized.

flagship.heading: Four things that make a difference.
flagship.subhead: Lexena isn't just a transcriber. Here's what makes daily use actually work.

local.title: Everything stays on your machine, if you want.
local.body: GPU-accelerated whisper.cpp (Vulkan) with CPU fallback. No connection required. No data leaves. No per-minute cost.

ai.title: Reframed without becoming unreadable.
ai.body: Ready-made modes: auto, email, formal, casual, bullet list, summary, grammar fix. Pick one per dictation. Original text always available.

notes.title: Your transcriptions become notes.
notes.body: Full rich editor: headings, code blocks, tables, tasks, images. @ backlinks between notes. Full-text search. Synced across devices, free.

profiles.title: A separate life per context.
profiles.body: Each profile has its own notes, history, hotkeys, dictionary. Instant switching. No leak from one context to another.

localCloud.heading: Both modes. No dogma.
localCloud.subhead: We don't push you toward either. Pick per dictation, or let auto-mode decide based on context.

features.metaDescription: Full inventory: dictation, local or cloud transcription, AI post-processing, connected notes, profiles, sync, system experience.

hero.title: Everything Lexena does.
hero.subhead: Without padding. Each feature listed ships in the current version.

items.title: Global shortcuts
items.body: Toggle (Ctrl+Alt+Space by default), push-to-talk (F8), cancel (Esc). Fully remappable, conflicts detected.

items.title: Local Whisper transcription
items.body: whisper.cpp with Vulkan acceleration on most recent GPUs. Multilingual model bundled. No connection required.

items.title: Lexena Cloud transcription
items.body: Premium transcription service operated by Lexena. More accurate on tough audio. No server-side audio storage — everything comes back local.

items.title: Silence detection
items.body: Automatic stop at end of dictation when you go quiet. Toggle off for long pauses.

items.title: Floating mini-window
items.body: Always-on-top frameless HUD with live audio level, timer, and quick post-process / translate toggles.

items.title: Translation mode
items.body: Dictate in any language, output in English. Toggleable per dictation.

items.title: Ready-made modes
items.body: Auto, email, formal, casual, bullet list, short summary, grammar fix. Picked per dictation.

items.title: Custom mode
items.body: Define your own system prompt. Saved per profile.

items.title: Original text kept
items.body: Raw and reframed visible side-by-side in history. You keep the trace.

items.title: Cost visible
items.body: Exact cost shown per dictation. No surprise at the end of the month.

items.title: Rich TipTap editor
items.body: Headings, lists, tasks, code blocks, tables, images, quotes. Markdown under the hood.

items.title: @ backlinks
items.body: Type @ to reference another note. Bidirectional links visible in the right panel.

items.title: Pinning
items.body: Pin important transcriptions to keep them at the top of the timeline.

items.title: Full-text search
items.body: Fuzzy search across everything — titles, content, transcriptions, snippets.

items.title: Watertight workspaces
items.body: Notes, history, shortcuts, dictionaries: each profile is isolated. No leak across contexts.

items.title: Instant switching
items.body: One shortcut or a click in the system tray. No restart.

items.title: Per-profile hotkeys
items.body: The same shortcut can do different things depending on the active profile.

items.title: In-app sign up
items.body: Account is created inside Lexena, not on this site. TOTP 2FA, one-click account deletion.

items.title: Free notes sync
items.body: Your notes, dictionaries, and preferences synced across devices. Included, no subscription.

items.title: Multi-device
items.body: Connect as many Windows machines as you want with a single account.

items.title: 100% offline mode
items.body: The account is optional. Lexena works fully without signing up.

items.title: System tray
items.body: Lexena lives in the Windows tray. Optional auto-start at login.

items.title: Light & dark themes
items.body: Dark by default. Manual toggle or system follow.

items.title: Bilingual EN / FR
items.body: Full UI in both languages. Hot-swap any time.

items.title: Signed updates
items.body: Cryptographically signed auto-update. Release notes visible before installing.

items.title: Deep links
items.body: lexena:// — from any app, open a note, start a dictation, run a command.

items.q: Do I need an account to use Lexena?
items.a: No. Lexena works entirely without an account. Sign-up is only needed if you want to sync your notes across multiple devices, and it happens in-app.

items.q: Are my audios sent to third-party servers?
items.a: In local mode, never. In Lexena Cloud mode, audio is processed by our infrastructure and erased immediately after transcription. We do not store any audio server-side.

items.q: What about the old OpenAI / Groq / Deepgram API keys?
items.a: BYO API keys are being phased out for the public v3.0 release, replaced by Lexena Cloud. Users on previous versions will be guided through the migration.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.draftWarning: Draft document. Will be reviewed by legal counsel before Lexena's public release.

sections.title: What Lexena collects
sections.body: In 100% local mode: nothing. In cloud mode with an account: email, hashed password, sync metadata. Audio is never stored server-side.

sections.title: Where it lives
sections.body: Notes and preferences: Supabase (European Union). Audio in transit for cloud transcription: erased after processing, never stored.

sections.title: Your rights
sections.body: One-click account deletion in-app. Full notes export. GDPR requests: contact@lexena.[domain] (TBD).

sections.title: Cookies & analytics
sections.body: The marketing site uses Plausible (cookieless, GDPR-compliant without a banner). The desktop app sends no telemetry.

sections.title: Software license
sections.body: Lexena Desktop is distributed under the MIT License. Source available on GitHub. Lexena Cloud is a hosted service governed by these terms.

sections.title: Ownership of your data
sections.body: Your notes, transcriptions, dictionaries, and snippets belong to you. Lexena claims no rights on the content you produce.

sections.title: Acceptable use
sections.body: Lexena must not be used to transcribe conversations without participants' consent. Compliance with local audio recording laws is the user's responsibility.

sections.title: Liability limits
sections.body: Lexena is provided "as is". No guarantee of cloud service availability. No liability for data loss — export your notes regularly.
